messages.subject: Release of seewave 2.1.8
messages.body_plain:
Dear seewave users,

A new version of seewave (2.1.8) has been pushed to CRAN.

Please see the changes listed below.

Thanks to Pierre Aumond, Guillaume Corbeau, Sylvain Haupert, Andrey Anikin, Yannick Jadoul, Marianna Anichini and Maria A. Wis for their contribution!

Enjoy,

Jerome

---

OTHER CHANGES
o TFSD(): a new function to compute the normalized Time and Frequency Second Derivative as described by Aumond et al. (2017). By Pierre Aumond and Guillaume Corbeau.
o specprop(): a correction regarding the frequency limits.
o spectro(): the argument 'noisereduction' now takes a value of 1 or 2 for applying the noise reduction according to the rows (1) or columns (2) of the spectrogram. Inspired by Sylvain Haupert.
o spectro(): the argument 'cexaxis' now works when 'scale=TRUE' and 'osc=FALSE'.
o spectro() and all functions based on the Fourier transform: 'gaussian' and 'bartlett' window asymetry fixed when n is even. By Andrey Anikin.
o timer(): a correction when the sounds ends with a signal section. By Yannick Jadoul and Marianna Anichini.
        o timer(): a bug fixed regarding the first element detected is short than 'dmin'. By Yannick Jadoul.
o wf(): faster display. By Maria A. Wis.
